title: No Elytra Boost
description: A data pack that breaks Elytra instantly when a player attempts a firework boost.
body:
# No Elytra Boost
This data pack is simple, light weight, and makes it so Elytra break instantly when a firework boost is attempted.

**Tested only on 1.21.8, may work on earlier versions that aren't earlier than 1.21**

## Features:
- Elytra break instantly when a firework boost is attempted.
- The firework's lifetime is set to 0, causing it to explode or disappear to prevent weird visual oddities.
- Light weight (Only uses 1 scoreboard and about ~18 commands)
